title: Spring Boot 3 Metric Detail
description: Micrometer metric detail response returned by Spring Boot 3 Actuator /metrics/{name} endpoint. Contains measurements, available tags, and metric metadata.

description.description: Human-readable metric description from Micrometer registration.

baseUnit.description: Base measurement unit (bytes, seconds, operations, etc.).

measurements.description: Current measurement values for the metric.

availableTags.description: Tag dimensions available for filtering this metric.

Measurement.title: Measurement
Measurement.description: A single statistical measurement value for a metric.

value.description: Current numeric value of the measurement.

TagValues.title: Tag Values
TagValues.description: A tag dimension with all observed values.

tag.description: Tag name (e.g., area, pool, uri, method, status).

values.description: All observed values for this tag.
